product.title: Kidnapped Robert Louis Stevenson 1913 Scribners Green Cloth Illustrated HC
product.description:
Kidnapped — Robert Louis Stevenson

A 1913 Charles Scribner’s Sons printing of Stevenson’s Scottish adventure, bound in green ribbed cloth with gilt spine lettering and a gilt front monogram. A black-and-white frontispiece and its tissue guard are shown in the photographs.

Condition

Acceptable vintage hardcover. No dust jacket. Cloth shows rubbing, scuffs, small spots and wear to the corners and spine ends, including small frayed areas. Pages show age toning and spotting, with a stain along the lower edge of the title page. The tissue guard is toned; page edges are uneven, and the hinges show wear. Not inspected page by page; interior completeness and binding strength have not been fully checked. Please review all seven photographs.

Details

  • Title: Kidnapped: Being Memoirs of the Adventures of David Balfour in the Year 1751
  • Author: Robert Louis Stevenson
  • Publisher: Charles Scribner’s Sons, New York
  • Title page dated 1913; later printing, with no first-edition claim
  • Green cloth hardcover with gilt decoration; English language
  • Approximately 7¾ × 5⅜ × 1¼ inches; book-only weight 1 lb 4.8 oz

Included

One hardcover book. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
